#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long mod = 998244353;
vector<long long> fact, revFact;

long long mul(long long x, long long y) {
    return (x * y) % mod;
}

long long pow_mod(long long x, long long y) {
    if (y < 0) return 0;
    long long res = 1;
    long long base = x % mod;
    long long exp = y;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long div_mod(long long x, long long y) {
    return (x * pow_mod(y, mod - 2)) % mod;
}

void preFact(int n) {
    fact.resize(n + 1);
    revFact.resize(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        fact[i + 1] = mul(i + 1, fact[i]);
    }
    revFact[n] = div_mod(1, fact[n]);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        revFact[i] = mul(revFact[i + 1], i + 1);
    }
}

long long cmb(int a, int b) {
    if (a < b) return 0;
    return mul(mul(fact[a], revFact[b]), revFact[a - b]);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    long long tmp;
    cin >> n >> tmp;
    if (n <= tmp) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    int k = (int)tmp;
    preFact(400000);
    long long answer = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    long long totalComb = cmb(n, n - k);
    for (int i = n - k; i >= 1; i--) {
        long long term = mul(cmb(n - k, i), pow_mod(i, n));
        if (sign == -1) {
            answer -= term;
        } else {
            answer += term;
        }
        answer %= mod;
        sign *= -1;
    }
    answer = (answer * totalComb) % mod;
    if (k != 0) answer = (answer * 2) % mod;
    if (answer < 0) answer += mod;
    cout << answer << "\n";
    return 0;
}
